source: Daemon API transfer phases and latest activity attempt records, 2026-10-08
confirmed: Current peer implementation independently packs and hashes a whole-workspace archive for each consumer; the same micro producer repeated this work for two similarly sized archive transfers.
notYetProven: The relative contributions of micro shared CPU, concurrent compression, disk contention and network throughput require separate validation. Size equality alone does not prove immutable content identity.
preservation: Required producer workspaces remain retained; no required output was intentionally destroyed. Runtime response is preserved in ignored local storage.
requiredFix: Coordinate sealed immutable snapshots by exact cloud generation and workspace identity, preserving full-workspace content validation, independent dependency routing and the joint consumer barrier. Do not reuse mutable content or remove an archive while a reader owns it.
limitations: Recovered experiment, not an uninterrupted benchmark.
Public-cloud pricing and micro speedup remain uncalibrated.
Goal remains incomplete until 58 activities, physical final product, comparative metrics and paid-resource cleanup are verified.
